pdf.js 2.16.105 legacy UMD (Apache-2.0)
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Build: pdfjs-dist 2.16.105 legacy (classic scripts, not the 4.x ESM build).
Why 2.x: 4.x uses dynamic import(); the GifOS app CSP has no blob: in script-src,
so that build cannot load. 2.16 is classic scripts + a blob: worker, which
capabilities.wasm allows. The app runs it with isEvalSupported:false so its
new Function/eval paths are never taken, and mints the worker itself via
workerPort (worker-src blob:) so pdf.js never tries to load the worker as a
<script> (blocked by script-src).

pdf.worker.min.js 1111587 19bf7ed5cdfdbe980a68e5096bb20ab9862be8e65d9ae4f82ac18d2bcfacbb40

Same pin as apps/pdf-tables/vendor (the sandbox-proven recipe).
COPYING-pdfjs.txt is the Apache-2.0 notice from that tree.
